agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has zero initial pole angle but high seeded sensor_noise (0.0145) with large dt (~0.0194). Controller receives noisy theta measurement, causing over-aggressive/phase-lagged forces (e.g., 37.7 N at step 30 while theta ~ -0.03 rad still near upright). This injects energy (energy rises to ~32 vs E0~1) and drives cart velocity to ~7.5 m/s and pole omega to -12.3 rad/s, swinging pole past 0.8 rad limit by step 34. Counterfactual with sensor_noise=0 otherwise identical does not violate.
